D. Annual maintenance of the park-and-ride.
analysis: 公告说明 Harbor Road 周日上午封闭的原因是'city marathon'，选 C。A 的重铺路面、B 的电影拍摄均未提及；D 把增频的 park-and-ride 误当作封路原因。因果细节题要抓 'for + 原因'。

stem: Section 2 (monologue, number detail). Transcript: 'For the litter-picking event we need at least fifteen volunteers per shift, though last year only twelve turned up for the afternoon one. This year we have twenty-two confirmed for the morning already.' Question: How many volunteers are needed for each shift?
analysis: 原文说'每个班次需要至少 15 人'，选 D。12 是去年下午班实到人数；22 是今年上午已确认人数；30 无中生有。数字题需区分'需要的人数/实到人数/已确认人数'三类。

stem: Section 4 (lecture). Transcript: 'Roman aqueducts maintained a gradient of roughly one part in four thousand—so gentle that water moved silently, without the erosion that steeper channels cause. Surveyors achieved this precision over dozens of kilometres using simple instruments: chorobates and gromas.' Question: What does the lecturer emphasise about Roman aqueducts?
options: A. Their extremely gentle, precisely maintained gradient.
B. Their use of pumped pressure to move water uphill.
C. The speed at which the water travelled.
D. Their reliance on imported engineers.
analysis: 讲者强调约 1:4000 的极缓坡度，水因而安静流动、不侵蚀渠道，且测量员凭简单仪器在数十公里内维持这一精度，选 A。B 的'泵压上山'与重力输水相反；C 强调的是'安静'而非'速度'；D 无中生有。

stem: Section 3 (discussion). Transcript: W: I've looked at your methodology chapter. The sample of thirty is workable, but you don't explain how you selected participants. M: They're students from my halls of residence. W: That's convenience sampling—you'll need to acknowledge it as a limitation. Question: What does the supervisor point out?
options: A. The sampling method is convenience sampling and should be acknowledged as a limitation.
B. The sample is too small to analyse at all.
C. The participants should have been strangers.
D. The methodology chapter should be deleted.
analysis: 导师指出'从自己宿舍选人'属于便利抽样，并要求在论文中承认为局限，选 A。B 与 'sample of thirty is workable' 相反；C、D 均未提及。考点是学术术语 convenience sampling 与 limitation 的对应。

stem: Section 1 (conversation). Transcript: W: I keep getting headaches in the afternoon. M: Do you drink much coffee? W: Three or four cups before noon. M: Try cutting to one, and sip water through the day—caffeine withdrawal and dehydration are common triggers. Come back in a fortnight if it persists. Question: What does the pharmacist advise?
options: A. To stop drinking coffee immediately and completely.
B. To take prescription painkillers every afternoon.
C. To reduce caffeine and drink more water.
D. To see an eye doctor about her vision.
analysis: 药剂师建议把咖啡减到一杯并在白天持续补水，指出咖啡因与脱水是常见诱因，选 C。A 的'立即完全戒断'过于绝对（是'减到一杯'）；B、D 均未提及。

stem: Section 3 (discussion, date detail). Transcript: M: My draft is due on the 5th of November, but I've had a family emergency. W: You can apply for a five-day extension—that takes it to the 10th. M: And if I need longer? W: Then it goes to the extensions committee, which meets on the 12th. Question: What is the new deadline if the extension is granted?
analysis: 五天延期把截止日期从 5 日推到 10 日，选 D。5 日是原截止日；12 日是委员会会议日期（仅在需更长期限时相关）；15 日无中生有。日期推算题要边听边做加法。

stem: Section 4 (lecture). Transcript: 'Schools near flight paths report a pattern: reading comprehension scores dip during take-off hours and recover once planes stop. Laboratory work corroborates this—tasks requiring recall of word lists are measurably slower under aircraft noise, though simple arithmetic seems unaffected.' Question: What did the laboratory studies find?
options: A. All cognitive tasks are slowed equally by aircraft noise.
B. Aircraft noise has no measurable effect on any task.
C. Word-list recall slows under aircraft noise, but simple arithmetic is largely unaffected.
D. Students near flight paths score higher than average.
analysis: 实验室研究的结果是：飞机噪声下'词汇表回忆明显变慢'，但'简单算术似乎不受影响'，C 完整对应两点。A 的'所有任务同等变慢'与算术不受影响矛盾；B 与回忆变慢矛盾；D 与阅读分数下降相反。

stem: Section 2 (monologue). Transcript: 'From this month, every bicycle kept on campus must be registered—free of charge—at the security office. Registered frames are etched with a serial number, which has cut theft at other universities by half. Unregistered bikes left in racks after exams will be removed.' Question: What will happen to unregistered bicycles left after exams?
options: A. They will be sold at auction.
B. They will be given to charity shops.
C. They will be confiscated and their owners fined £50.
D. They will be removed by the university.
analysis: 原文最后一句明确：'考试后留在车架上的未注册自行车将被移走'，选 D。A 的拍卖、B 的捐赠、C 的 50 英镑罚款均未提及。注册免费、刻号防盗是背景信息，不是本题所问。

stem: Section 3 (discussion). Transcript: M: Shall we split the presentation—you take the historical background, I'll do the case studies? W: Actually, the brief says the analysis section carries the most marks, so maybe we should work on that together. M: Fair enough—we'll each draft a background chapter, then combine them into the analysis. Question: What do the speakers decide?
options: A. To collaborate on the high-value analysis section.
B. To divide the work into two separate halves.
C. To present only the case studies.
D. To ask for an extension on the presentation.
analysis: 女生指出'分析部分占分最高'，两人决定共同完成该部分，选 A。B 的'各分一半'是最初提议、最终被否；C、D 均未提及。听力对话题要注意'提议—修正—最终决定'的推进。

stem: Section 1 (conversation, spelling detail). Transcript: M: And your delivery address? W: Flat 4, 28 Larchmont Avenue—that's L-A-R-C-H-M-O-N-T. M: Larchfield, was it? W: No—Larchmont, like the tree. Question: How is the street name spelled?
analysis: 女士拼读并纠正了男士的误听：L-A-R-C-H-M-O-N-T（'像那种树一样'），选 B。A 是男士的误听 Larchfield；C 把 R 换成 T；D 在结尾多了 U。拼写题务必听清纠正式对话的最终版本。

stem: Section 4 (lecture). Transcript: 'Shackleton's Endurance sank in 1915, yet the expedition is remembered as a triumph of leadership: after months drifting on ice, he sailed a small boat 1,300 kilometres to South Georgia and returned to rescue every one of his stranded men.' Question: Why does the lecturer call the expedition a triumph?
options: A. Because the ship reached the South Pole first.
B. Because valuable minerals were discovered.
C. Because all the crew members were eventually rescued.
D. Because the ship survived the ice undamaged.
analysis: 讲者称其为领导力的胜利：乘小艇 1300 公里到南乔治亚岛后返回，救回'每一名'被困船员，选 C。A 与'船沉没、目标失败'的背景不符；B 无中生有；D 与 sank in 1915 矛盾。

stem: Section 1 (conversation). Transcript: M: Insurance claims department. W: I want to claim for a laptop damaged during a flight last week. M: Do you have the baggage tag and the damage report from the airline? W: I kept the tag, but nobody at the airport gave me a report. M: Without that report we can't process the claim—I'd suggest contacting the airline's customer relations today. Question: What does the man tell the woman to do first?
options: A. Post the damaged laptop for inspection.
B. Contact the airline's customer relations to obtain the damage report.
C. Pay an excess fee before the claim starts.
D. Submit photos of her boarding pass.
analysis: 缺少航空公司的损坏报告就无法理赔，男士建议'今天就联系航司客服关系部门'，选 B。A 的寄检、C 的自付额、D 的登机牌照片均未提及。流程类听力要抓 'first/without...can't' 的先后与条件关系。

stem: Section 2 (zoo announcement). Transcript: 'Please note that the penguin feeding has moved from 2 p.m. to 3:30, to match the birds' natural activity peak. The sea lion show continues twice daily, at 11 and 4, as before.' Question: What has changed at the zoo?
options: A. The sea lion show now runs three times a day.
B. The penguin feeding has been moved to a later time.
C. The zoo now closes earlier in winter.
D. The penguin enclosure is closed for cleaning.
analysis: 公告只宣布一处变化：企鹅喂食从下午 2 点改到 3:30，以配合其自然活动高峰，即'推迟'，选 B。海狮秀'照旧'每天 11 点与 4 点两场，排除 A；C、D 均未提及。

stem: Section 2 (news item, number detail). Transcript: 'Season tickets on the coastal line will rise by an average of four per cent from April, slightly below last year's increase of six per cent. Off-peak fares, however, will be frozen at current levels.' Question: By how much will season tickets rise?
analysis: 季票平均上涨 4%，选 D。6% 是去年涨幅；0% 是'非高峰票价冻结'，属张冠李戴；10% 无中生有。百分比题要区分'今年/去年'与'季票/非高峰票价'两组对照。

stem: Section 4 (lecture). Transcript: 'Children recognise brand logos before they can read, and studies show cartoon characters on packaging raise a product's perceived taste rating among five-year-olds. Several countries now restrict such characters on foods high in sugar, treating them as advertising to an audience that cannot critically evaluate it.' Question: Why do some countries restrict cartoon characters on sugary food packaging?
options: A. Because the characters increase shipping costs.
B. Because young children cannot critically evaluate the advertising.
C. Because the cartoons are protected by copyright.
D. Because packaging designs confuse parents.
analysis: 原文的政策理由是：卡通形象面向的是'无法批判性评估广告的受众'，即低龄儿童，选 B。A 的物流成本、C 的版权、D 的'让父母困惑'均未提及；考点在 'an audience that cannot critically evaluate it' 的同义转换。

stem: Section 3 (discussion). Transcript: W: I understood the lectures, but the exam questions ask me to choose which test to apply—I never know. M: The drop-in statistics clinic runs Tuesday afternoons. W: I went once; it was packed and I barely got five minutes. M: Book the online slots then—they open Fridays at noon and go fast. Question: What does the man recommend in the end?
options: A. Attending the crowded Tuesday clinic without booking.
B. Dropping the statistics module altogether.
C. Booking one of the online slots released on Fridays.
D. Hiring a private tutor for exam revision.
analysis: 对话的最终建议是'预约每周五中午开放的网络时段'，选 C。A 是已被否定的做法（拥挤、只有五分钟）；B、D 均未提及。注意 'in the end' 类题要选最后确定的方案，而非先前的失败尝试。

stem: Section 1 (conversation). Transcript: M: Lost property office, how can I help? W: I think I left a blue umbrella on the 42 bus this morning. M: Anything distinctive about it? W: It has a wooden handle with a small brass duck carved on it. M: Let me check... yes, one was handed in at about 11. You can collect it with photo ID. Question: How can the woman identify her umbrella?
options: A. It is the only blue umbrella on the bus.
B. It has a wooden handle with a small brass duck.
C. Her name is printed on the canopy.
D. It folds into a matching blue sleeve.
analysis: 女士描述伞的特征是'木柄上刻有一只小铜鸭'，这也是失物招领处的辨识依据，选 B。A 的'唯一'无从得知；C 的姓名、D 的收纳套均未提及。

stem: Section 1 (conversation, time detail). Transcript: M: Your flight BA-417 is now scheduled to arrive at 22:40, forty minutes later than planned, because of a late departure from Madrid. The last airport express bus leaves at 23:15, so you should still catch it if the flight isn't further delayed. Question: What is the new arrival time of the flight?
analysis: 航班新的到达时间是 22:40，比原计划晚 40 分钟（原为 22:00），选 D。23:15 是末班机场大巴时间；21:40 是'提前 40 分钟'的错误推算。时间题要区分'到达/发车'与'新旧时间'。
